intro.text: An Iriali Truthwatcher bonded to Uma, who runs a shop with her daughter Dyel.

items.text: Dyel and her mother met Hoid and a strange woman with many rings in the months before the migration.

Just before the migration, Demoux, Baon and Galladon came to her shop. Dyel mistook Baon for Nale come to kill her mother, as he had killed her grandfather Ym; when her mother returned, Uma cleared things up, and the family passed on a note from Hoid. Then Cusicesh rose from the bay to announce the migration, and Dyel, her mother and Uma set off through Shadesmar with the other Iriali.

appearance.text: She has typical Iriali golden skin and hair, and usually wears a bandeau with loose trousers.
